name: GeoNames
tagline: Global place-name and geospatial web services for cities, elevations, and postal codes
description: GeoNames provides free and commercial web services for geographic data: place search, reverse geocoding, postal codes, elevations, timezone lookup, and more, backed by a large open gazetteer of places worldwide.

auth.details: Username query parameter (username=YOUR_USERNAME); free account required; enable free web services in account settings

use_cases: reverse geocode coordinates to place names
look up timezone for a location
find postal codes for a place
